metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Raya and the Last Dragon and Kung Fu Panda, they will love this thrilling, heartwarming adventure about a young Viking and his loyal dragon.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A hilarious look at what pets do when their owners leave, perfect for fans of Despicable Me and Migration.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A super-funny villain-turned-hero story that matches the humorous, subverted-hero tone of Shrek and Despicable Me.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: They loved Monsters, Inc., so they will enjoy seeing how Mike and Sulley first met and became friends in college.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful Pixar coming-of-age story that combines the aquatic charm of Finding Nemo with the cozy, magical feel of Studio Ghibli films.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they've watched Frozen II, they should see the beloved original movie that started the global phenomenon of Elsa and Anna.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: This modern fantasy adventure about two elf brothers features the same emotional depth and fun world-building as Inside Out 2.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A classic Pixar comedy about an ant who recruits warrior bugs to save his colony, perfect for fans of Toy Story and Chicken Run.

metas.name: WALL-E
metas.description: An incredibly imaginative, visually stunning Pixar masterpiece that offers a fantastic sci-fi adventure for the whole family.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: This charming, emotional Pixar adventure about flying a house to South America shares the same heartfelt storytelling as Coco.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A fast-paced, funny superhero family dynamic that fans of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and Despicable Me will love.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A chaotic, hilarious, and heartwarming family road trip during a robot apocalypse with the same visual flair as Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: From Aardman Animations, the creators of Chicken Run and Wallace & Gromit, comes this incredibly funny, dialogue-free adventure.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A gorgeous Studio Ghibli film about tiny people living under the floorboards, matching the fantasy vibe of Kiki's Delivery Service and The Borrowers.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A sweet, gentle, and highly entertaining animated adventure with Charlie Brown and Snoopy that is ideal for all ages.

metas.name: Klaus
metas.description: A beautifully animated, hilarious, and touching holiday origin story of Santa Claus that fans of That Christmas will love.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A young girl helps a lost Yeti return to his family in this beautiful, musical, and magical journey across China.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A delightful, warm live-action/CGI hybrid film about a polite bear from Peru adjusting to life in London, perfect for fans of Matilda.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Even better than the original, this masterpiece of family cinema is incredibly wholesome, funny, and visually magnificent.

metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: They have watched Inside Out 2, so they will love experiencing the imaginative original film that introduced Riley's emotions.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: An action-packed Disney adventure featuring Baymax, the lovable inflatable robot, perfect for fans of the high-energy Sonic films.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: An arcade-hopping adventure packed with video game cameos that fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Sonic the Hedgehog will enjoy.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: An incredibly clever, fast-paced comedy adventure that will keep kids laughing from start to finish, just like Despicable Me.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Continuing Po's journey, this entry has him teaching a village of clumsy pandas to fight, perfect since they watched parts 1 and 2.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: Since they enjoyed the first two films, they'll love seeing Gru meet his cheerful twin brother, Dru, for more villainous fun.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An absurdly funny and creative animated adventure about a scientist who invents a machine that makes food fall from the sky.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A spooky-but-silly monster comedy that offers a family-friendly laugh fest, matching the vibe of The Bad Guys.

metas.name: Arthur Christmas
metas.description: An inventive, modern, and funny look at how Santa's high-tech operation delivers presents, from the co-producers of Chicken Run.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A highly energetic, joke-packed zoo break adventure that fans of Ice Age and Zootopia will absolutely love.

metas.name: Ice Age: The Meltdown
metas.description: They loved the original Ice Age, so they will enjoy seeing Manny, Sid, and Diego navigate a melting landscape and meet Ellie the mammoth.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Since they watched Simba's Pride and Mufasa, they should experience the definitive animated Disney masterpiece that started it all.

metas.name: Babe
metas.description: A heartwarming family classic about a polite young pig who learns to herd sheep, sharing a lovely country setting with Chicken Run.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A beautiful, song-filled animated fantasy about a girl who builds a rocket ship to find a mythical moon goddess, echoing the spirit of Moana.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A colorful, action-packed prehistoric family adventure filled with unique creatures and massive laughs, appealing to fans of Ice Age.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: A hilarious spin-off focusing on the mischievous yellow Minions' quest to find an evil master before meeting Gru.

metas.name: Ferdinand
metas.description: A heartwarming and sweet story about a gentle, flower-loving giant bull who refuses to fight, perfect for fans of Rio and Zootopia.

metas.name: Flushed Away
metas.description: This DreamWorks/Aardman collaboration about a high-society pet rat flushed down the toilet is packed with the same witty humor as Chicken Run.

metas.name: Mary and the Witch's Flower
metas.description: A beautiful fantasy about a girl who discovers a flower that grants her temporary magical powers, matching the charm of Ghibli films.

metas.name: The Princess and the Frog
metas.description: A wonderful Disney musical set in New Orleans with gorgeous hand-drawn animation, jazzy songs, and great humor, perfect for fans of Tangled.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: An exceptional sequel that expands the world, adds breathtaking flying sequences, and introduces new, lovable dragon species.
